acceptance_criteria.statement: Envelope fields: schema rizzstack.preauth/2 and id, issuer, issued_at, expires_at, nonce, action_class, repos, bases, contracts, review, budget, conditions, max_uses, created_from; the JSON schema and the checker require exactly these (additionalProperties false).
A malformed envelope (missing or extra field, duplicate key, non-object) refuses envelope_schema_invalid before any other check.
A correctly signed, in-date, unrevoked envelope authorizes exactly the listed contract and returns its envelope_id, contract_sha256 and max_tier.

The signature is verified with ssh-keygen -Y verify against policy/allowed_signers, identity = envelope issuer, namespace rizzstack-preauth, over the exact committed bytes; tampered bytes, a key not in allowed_signers, another namespace, a garbage signature or an issuer that is not the signing principal refuse envelope_bad_signature.
now >= expires_at refuses envelope_expired.
now < issued_at refuses envelope_not_yet_valid.
expires_at more than 7 days after issued_at refuses envelope_ttl_exceeded, even if signed.
An envelope id in the measured revocation list refuses envelope_revoked, effective immediately; revocation needs no signature.
A repository not in repos refuses envelope_repo_mismatch.
The current base must descend from bases[repo] (caller-provided is_ancestor); false or no ancestry fact refuses envelope_base_mismatch.
A contract_sha256 not listed for this repo refuses envelope_contract_not_listed.
Never-pre-authorizable action classes (gate/lane, rulesets, deploy, force-push, preauth widening) refuse envelope_action_forbidden; the policy names every never-pre-authorizable class.
A re-freeze (contracts[].refreeze_of) is allowed only when the oracle files are identical at the old and new source_rev; product code may differ.

Changing, adding or removing any frozen test, conftest, pytest config (pytest.ini, tox.ini, setup.cfg, pyproject.toml), fixture/data file, tests/plugins hook, sitecustomize/usercustomize or .pth refuses envelope_oracle_changed; oracle_paths defines that set.
A re-freeze without a measured oracle fact refuses envelope_oracle_unproven.
Measured uses of the envelope >= min(max_uses, budget.max_merges) refuse envelope_budget_exhausted.
A second use of the same envelope for the same contract refuses envelope_replayed.
A nonce already recorded for a different envelope id refuses envelope_nonce_reused.
Key custody: scripts/preauth.py only verifies (no sign/mint/generate function, no ssh-keygen -Y sign, no private key text); NAMESPACE and MAX_TTL_SECONDS are constants.

policy/allowed_signers exists and every entry is a public ssh-ed25519 or sk-ssh-ed25519 key restricted to namespaces="rizzstack-preauth"; no tracked file contains an OpenSSH private key. An empty (comments only) file is valid and refuses every envelope.

policy/preauth.md states signed approval (ssh-keygen -Y sign, rizzstack-preauth, policy/allowed_signers, key never on the Hermes host), revoke preauth <id> effective immediately, and that agents never create, widen or extend envelopes.
policy/preauth.md proposes P1-P5 with their mechanical conditions, requires proving every condition from data, a ledger and a daily digest.
P1 is the first numbered condition and requires frozen test blobs, conftest, pytest config and fixtures identical at the old and new source_rev.

assumptions: ssh-keygen with -Y (OpenSSH >= 8.2) is present on the box and on GitHub-hosted runners; the checker refuses envelope_bad_signature if it is missing.
Facts (revocations, consumed uses, nonces, oracle blob maps, ancestry) are measured by the caller from GitHub and git; this slice only decides from them.
tests/test_preauth_policy.py is r3's file with one test re-cut (hash approval -> signed approval) and FIELDS extended; the other seven r3 tests are unchanged.
policy/allowed_signers ships with comments only; the owner adds a public key in a separate owner-approved change.

observable_behavior: check() returns ok only for a valid, in-date, unrevoked, listed, in-budget, first use

named refusals: envelope_schema_invalid, envelope_bad_signature, envelope_expired, envelope_not_yet_valid, envelope_ttl_exceeded, envelope_revoked, envelope_action_forbidden, envelope_repo_mismatch, envelope_base_mismatch, envelope_contract_not_listed, envelope_oracle_unproven, envelope_oracle_changed, envelope_budget_exhausted, envelope_replayed, envelope_nonce_reused
the module verifies and never signs
outcome.summary: Re-cut of preauth-policy r3 (c05c62c7) with the r2 checker folded in. The owner signs one bounded envelope with ssh-keygen -Y sign -n rizzstack-preauth on their own machine; the repository holds only public keys in policy/allowed_signers, and the coordinator never holds a signing key. scripts/preauth.py (stdlib plus ssh-keygen) verifies the signature over the committed bytes and decides one use from measured facts, refusing with a named reason on any doubt. Wiring the checker into the gate/lane is out of scope (authority slice).
